name: Where the Dreamers Bleed
source:
Dreams are traps for the soul. Each one carries consequences. Every mistake and every attempt to change the established order will return you to the source. Will you accept what is revealed without breaking under the weight of events?

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/Wtdbnovella/261]Telegram[/url]]
